settings.heading: The simplicity of something complex.
settings.text: Grace is chief engineer to the country's best. Every bat is the sum of a method Pete has spent a lifetime refining, in the relentless hunt for the 1% that turns an out into a six.

settings.heading: One engineer. Every car.
settings.text: Picture the best Formula 1 drivers in the world, each racing a different car. Pete has been chief engineer and pit crew for all of them. Grace Cricket is the culmination of that: a maker who has worked on every car, now building his own.
settings.caption: Grace / the engineer

settings.title: Process
settings.text: Organised steps, led by research into what the best players actually need. Pete quantifies what he believes delivers performance, then builds to it. Logical, and simple.

settings.title: Performance
settings.text: A better bat lifts performance through confidence and evidence. This is the 1%: a few more horsepower into the bat, the fractional edge that decides six or out.

settings.title: Innovation
settings.text: Constant evolution. Always adjusting for improvement, always hunting the next unicorn: better grip, less sweat, lighter gear, a truer middle.

settings.title: Data
settings.text: Figures up front, chosen by more of the best than any other. Specs and transparency now, and more as the proof builds over time. No bull.

settings.heading: How a Grace bat is made.
settings.text: Not all of it is data. It is process, performance and innovation, with data as the proof underneath.

settings.title: The handle.
settings.text: Pete's signature shape, perfected over hours with the top players. The "gold" that runs through every bat.

settings.title: Hand-selected willow.
settings.text: No retail grades. Pete selects every cleft himself, and the price tells you where a bat sits.

settings.title: Plays lighter than it weighs.
settings.text: More mass, perfectly balanced, so more energy goes into the ball.

settings.title: The 1%.
settings.text: The DeChambeau logic: chase the fractional edge everyone else leaves on the table.

settings.heading: Chosen by more of the country's best than any other.
The method is in every bat.
settings.text: Find the one that's yours, or see the range.
